svg.title: Wastewater operator — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as wastewater operator, wearing coveralls and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A submersible pump sits in an open sump and connects to a tall rising discharge pipe above the waterline. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
